Selected publications on **artificial intelligence, Earth observation, and natural hazards**, including work by Lorenzo Nava and collaborators.

[King’s research profile](https://kclpure.kcl.ac.uk/portal/en/persons/lorenzo.nava/) · [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2327-8721) · [Code & Data](code-data.qmd)

Last updated: **31 October 2026**.
